scope: independent supplemental small-display and contrast-pressure visual recheck of the eight current v2 atlases

new_method.name: multi-size squint and contrast stress review
new_method.purpose: 在 24x26、32x35、48x52 显示尺寸下，将每帧叠加深色、浅色和高饱和背景，并用灰度 alpha 轮廓和轻度模糊检查主体可读性、局部压扁、边缘闪烁与对比度骤降
new_method.status: completed; all selected candidates were inspected at normal display size

result.release_effect: supplemental evidence only; the eight complete-row regeneration blockers remain open

limitations: 这是感知压力测试，不是 Codex App 的真实 GPU、窗口层级或多屏验收
低对比度可能来自角色本身的合法深色材质，必须结合正常尺寸和动作语义判断
指标候选不能替代完整动作行重生和 hatch-pet 全部门禁
